coder_notes: Radiotherapy trial (PET-guided dose-escalated hypofractionation vs standard). Only drug is temozolomide, given in both arms and not itself tested, so listed as soc_backbone and no candidate exists. F-DOPA PET tracer is imaging for target delineation and not a registered intervention, so not listed. Conditions field says only 'Glioma' but title and inclusion name GBM.
